stations.name: Bharati Antarctic Research Station
stations.power_source: Combined Heat & Power Cogeneration (3x 100 kVA Scania Generators) + 25 kW Solar Array
stations.habitat_description: State-of-the-art 3-story prefabricated modular container building elevated on stilts to prevent snow drift accumulation. Features advanced optical, atmospheric and geomagnetism laboratories.

stations.name: Maitri Antarctic Research Station
stations.location_description: Schirmacher Oasis, Queen Maud Land (Inland Rocky Oasis)
stations.comms_type: Inmarsat & Ku-Band VSAT (4 Mbps Backup Link)
stations.power_source: Triple Diesel Generator Plant (2x 62.5 kVA Kirloskar + 1x Standby) + Pilot Wind Turbines
stations.habitat_description: India second permanent Antarctic station located next to Lake Priyadarshini. Steel-framed insulated building complex housing biology, meteorology, and solid-earth physics labs.

stations.name: Dakshin Gangotri Depot & Automated Station
stations.location_description: Princess Astrid Coast, Ice Shelf (Glacial Shelf Zone)
stations.comms_type: Automated Iridium SBD Beacon & VHF Relay (Sub-GHz telemetry)
stations.power_source: Extreme-Cold Solar Array + RTG / Lithium-Thionyl Chloride Battery Bank
stations.habitat_description: Historic first Indian Antarctic base; the original main station submerged under ice sheet subsidence by 1990. Currently operating as an unmanned autonomous meteorological & transit logistics depot.

alerts.title: Katabatic Wind Storm Warning (55.0 kts)
alerts.message: Severe katabatic wind velocity of 55.0 kts recorded at Bharati Antarctic Research Station. Outdoor research operations suspended.

alerts.title: Katabatic Wind Storm Warning (64.3 kts)
alerts.message: Severe katabatic wind velocity of 64.3 kts recorded at Dakshin Gangotri Depot & Automated Station. Outdoor research operations suspended.

alerts.title: Extreme Deep-Freeze Alert (-44.3°C)
alerts.message: Extreme low ambient temperature of -44.3°C detected at Dakshin Gangotri Depot & Automated Station. Life-support heating redundancy engaged.

alerts.title: [DEMO] Extreme Katabatic Gale Storm (-37.8°C / 58.5 kts)
alerts.message: SIMULATED DATA: Severe katabatic winds exceeding 58 knots with equivalent wind chill of -58°C reported across Schirmacher Oasis. Station Commander enforced Code Red curfew; all 22 crew sheltered in main habitat.

alerts.title: [DEMO] Polar Diesel Fuel Storage Below 20% Reserve
alerts.message: SIMULATED DATA: Available fuel reserves at Maitri have decreased to 8,400 Litres (~22.1 days remaining runway at 380 L/day). Energy conservation protocol engaged; non-critical labs on standby power.

alerts.title: [DEMO] Automated Depot Iridium Uplink Latency Spike (2,450 ms)
alerts.message: SIMULATED DATA: Princess Astrid Coast unmanned depot telemetry transponder latency spiked to 2,450 ms with 22% packet loss on Sub-GHz meteorological payload radio link.

alerts.title: [DEMO] Exterior Air Intake Duct Frost Accretion Warning
alerts.message: SIMULATED DATA: Ambient temperature -26.4°C with moist onshore blizzard drift caused partial icing on Hab Ventilation Intake C. Trace heating coils operating at 92% load.

alerts.title: [DEMO] Ku-Band VSAT 3.8m Tracking Gimbal Azimuth Jitter
alerts.message: SIMULATED DATA: Sastrugi snow pack vibration causing 1.5° intermittent tracking error on Ku-band satellite uplink. Bandwidth throttled to 8.2 Mbps.

alerts.title: [DEMO] North Airlock Silicone Door Seal Inspection Overdue
alerts.message: SIMULATED DATA: Scheduled thermal inspection of pneumatic insulated seals on North Hab Airlock is 3 days overdue. Thermal imaging detected frost bridge along threshold.

alerts.title: [DEMO] Emergency Hypothermia Kits Below Safety Buffer
alerts.message: SIMULATED DATA: Available dispensary inventory has dropped to 8 kits (minimum safety baseline is 10 kits). Resupply requested for next seasonal tractor convoy.

alerts.title: [DEMO] High-Calorie Survival Rations Depletion Warning
alerts.message: SIMULATED DATA: Unmanned depot container #2 ration cache is down to 380 kg (safety baseline 300 kg). Runway remains at ~95 days for transit personnel.

alerts.title: [DEMO] Cogeneration Secondary Coolant Loop Pressure Swing
alerts.message: SIMULATED DATA: Secondary heat recovery circuit reported minor pressure oscillations between 2.2 and 3.4 bar. Bypass valve engaged smoothly.

alerts.title: [DEMO] Reverse Osmosis Unit #2 Inspection Scheduled
alerts.message: SIMULATED DATA: Desalination filter membrane 500-hour routine cleaning scheduled within 48 hours to preserve freshwater production efficiency.

alerts.title: [DEMO] Meteorological Mast Guy Wire Rigging Inspection Due
alerts.message: SIMULATED DATA: Periodic tension test on stainless steel anchor guy wires due within 12 days prior to winter storm season.

alerts.title: [DEMO] Optical Observatory Roof Heater Circuit Tripped
alerts.message: SIMULATED DATA: Overload protection tripped circuit breaker CB-12 on optical aurora camera dome heater during heavy riming.
alerts.resolution_notes: Thermal breaker reset, frost cleared, heating tape load verified nominal at 2.4 kW.

alerts.title: [DEMO] Generator #1 Fuel Pre-Heater Temperature Drift
alerts.message: SIMULATED DATA: Viscosity heating coil RTD probe registered +6°C drift during diesel pre-heating cycle.
alerts.resolution_notes: Replaced faulty PT100 sensor with spare from workshop locker. Output stabilized.

incidents.title: [DEMO] Greywater Bioseparator Heating Coil Failure in -38°C Gale
incidents.description: SIMULATED DATA: Thermal overload sensor tripped breaker Q4 in waste treatment module during sub-zero katabatic wind. Emergency heat tracing required to prevent biological separator tank freeze-up.

incidents.title: [DEMO] Katabatic Gale Damage to Sonic Anemometer Mast B
incidents.description: SIMULATED DATA: Wind gusts exceeding 58 knots caused structural whipping on Mast B, severing signal cable to sonic anemometer #3. Surface wind telemetry operating on backup cup anemometer.

incidents.title: [DEMO] Heat Exchanger Loop B Pressure Oscillation
incidents.description: SIMULATED DATA: Cogeneration secondary coolant loop reported periodic pressure swings between 2.1 and 3.8 bar. Automated bypass valve engaged smoothly. No drop in habitat heating detected.

incidents.title: [DEMO] Airlock 2 Exterior Apron LED Floodlight Glaze-Over
incidents.description: SIMULATED DATA: Wind-driven sastrugi snow pack partially obscured safety floodlight #4 outside Hab Airlock 2. Advisory issued for outdoor night travel.

incidents.title: [DEMO] Diesel Transfer Pump B Vapor Lock During Bunker Transfer
incidents.description: SIMULATED DATA: Auxiliary transfer pump B lost suction during fuel transfer from Bunker 3. Purged air bleed port and replaced delivery check valve gasket.
incidents.resolution_summary: Air lock cleared, pump primed, and transfer completed at 45 L/min nominal rate.

incidents.title: [DEMO] Iridium SBD Beacon Packet Loss at Automated Depot
incidents.description: SIMULATED DATA: Automated depot beacon is dropping 22% of scheduled telemetry packets during high-ionospheric-noise periods. Remote reset completed; antenna feed and backup VHF relay require inspection.
incidents.equipment_system: Iridium SBD telemetry terminal and VHF relay mast

incidents.title: [DEMO] Atmospheric LIDAR Laser Chiller Temperature Drift
incidents.description: SIMULATED DATA: Laboratory LIDAR chiller outlet temperature is 4.2°C above its calibration envelope, placing the next upper-atmosphere observation run on hold pending a coolant loop inspection.

incidents.title: [DEMO] PistenBully Cargo Sled Brake-Line Pressure Drop
incidents.description: SIMULATED DATA: Scheduled resupply vehicle reported intermittent hydraulic brake pressure loss while maneuvering near the fuel farm. Vehicle grounded until the line is pressure-tested and the spare seal kit is installed.
incidents.resolution_summary: Brake hose flare retorqued, seal replaced, and static/load tests passed before vehicle release.

maintenanceTasks.title: [DEMO] Biannual Insulated Airlock Door Seal & De-Icer Inspection
maintenanceTasks.description: SIMULATED DATA: Inspect silicone pneumatic weather seals on Main North Airlock and South Survival Shelter. Test electric resistive heating tape along door thresholds.

maintenanceTasks.title: [DEMO] Solar Photovoltaic Array Snow Clearing & Inverter Calibration
maintenanceTasks.description: SIMULATED DATA: Clear sastrugi snow pack from rooftop south-facing solar modules (25 kW array). Check string voltages and ground fault protection relays.

maintenanceTasks.title: [DEMO] Monthly Oil & Filter Change - Scania Generator Unit #1
maintenanceTasks.description: SIMULATED DATA: Drain lubricant, replace Mobil Delvac 5W-40 (60L), replace primary and secondary fuel filter elements, inspect belt tension and coolant inhibitor.

maintenanceTasks.title: [DEMO] Lake Priyadarshini Water Extraction Line De-Icing Service
maintenanceTasks.description: SIMULATED DATA: Inspect vacuum trace heating cables along 450m insulated freshwater supply pipe running from Lake Priyadarshini to station holding tanks.

maintenanceTasks.title: [DEMO] Seasonal Transit Depot Survival Shelter Rigging Audit
maintenanceTasks.description: SIMULATED DATA: Inspect snow ablation around emergency cargo containers, check guy wires on met mast, replace Iridium antenna desiccant cartridges.

maintenanceTasks.title: [DEMO] Atmospheric LIDAR Laser Chiller Coolant Inspection
maintenanceTasks.description: SIMULATED DATA: Checked ethylene glycol concentration ratio (-50°C freeze rating verified). Refilled closed-loop chiller reservoir to nominal marker.

maintenanceTasks.title: [DEMO] Iridium Antenna Desiccant and Backup Relay Preventive Service
maintenanceTasks.description: SIMULATED DATA: Replace moisture cartridges, inspect coaxial connectors, and validate the backup VHF relay before the next autonomous telemetry window.

maintenanceTasks.title: [DEMO] Potable Water UV Sterilizer and Flow Sensor Calibration
maintenanceTasks.description: SIMULATED DATA: Verify UV dose output, clean the quartz sleeve, and calibrate the outlet flow sensor on the potable water treatment skid.

maintenanceTasks.title: [DEMO] Snowcat Emergency Beacon and Cabin Safety Kit Inspection
maintenanceTasks.description: SIMULATED DATA: Inspect vehicle beacon batteries, cabin fire suppressor seals, emergency oxygen kit, and tow-line condition before the next winter traverse.
